description: Source code for Bluetooth Audio Sink implementation, including callback handling, state management, and external interface functions for controlling Bluetooth audio sink behavior.

classes.name: AudioSink
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth audio sink interface, state, and data transmission, including callback registration and buffer management.

classes.name: SendBuffer
classes.description: Shared buffer used for writing audio data to the sink.

classes.name: Callback
classes.description: Callback handler for sink state changes.

methods.name: ConvertState
methods.description: Converts internal IBluetoothAudio state to BluetoothAudioSink state.

methods.name: AudioSink::Operational
methods.description: Handles operational state changes of the Bluetooth sink.

methods.name: AudioSink::RegisterOperationalStateUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for operational state updates.

methods.name: AudioSink::UnregisterOperationalStateUpdateCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for operational state updates.

methods.name: AudioSink::RegisterSinkStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for sink state changes.

methods.name: AudioSink::UnregisterSinkStateChangedCallback
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for sink state changes.

methods.name: AudioSink::State
methods.description: Retrieves current Bluetooth audio sink state.

methods.name: AudioSink::Configure
methods.description: Configures the sink with specified audio format.

methods.name: AudioSink::Acquire
methods.description: Acquires the sink for audio data transmission.

methods.name: AudioSink::Frame
methods.description: Sends a frame of audio data.
